activity.notes: Edward IV returned from exile and regained the English throne in 1471 after victories at Barnet and Tewkesbury. He remained King of England until his death in 1483. ATLAS records the restored reign as a separate Activity because Henry VI actually occupied the throne during Edward's 1470-1471 interruption.

sources.title: Edward IV — The Royal Family
sources.citation_text: The Royal Family records Edward IV's restoration in 1471 and gives his second reign as 1471-1483.

sources.title: King Edward IV — National Portrait Gallery
